caption: Your YouTube email library
setupIntro: Set up a local library for YouTube email notifications.
setupManualHelp: Add channels manually and check their public feeds. Configure email after setup.
setupCreateConfig: BBYEN will create the missing configuration files with manual tracking and no initial video backlog.
setupPreserveConfig: Your existing configuration will be kept. BBYEN will create only missing files.
setupFailed: Setup could not start. Check the service logs and try again.
setupOtherModes: YouTube account and cookie setup will be available in a later dashboard update.
testSent: Test email accepted by the mail server.
testUncertain: Delivery could not be confirmed. Check your inbox and email settings before trying again.
credentialsHelp: Enter only the credentials you want to change. Saved values are never shown.
environmentOwned: Set by the environment; change it in Portainer and restart.
emailSaveError: Could not save email settings. Check the fields and try again.
credentialsError: Could not save credentials. Check the fields and try again.
libraryNote: Your collection grows as BBYEN checks for new uploads.
importNeedsConsent: Confirm that invalid entries should be skipped before applying.
testHelp: Send a test using your saved email settings and credentials.
scheduleHelp: Use a number and unit, such as 6 hours or 3 days. The maximum is about 24 days. Changes apply without restarting.
scheduleError: Could not confirm the schedule. Check the intervals and reload before retrying.
exportHelp: Export channel lists and preferences without credentials or video history.
importHelp: Review additions, conflicts, and invalid entries before applying. No YouTube subscriptions or bells will be changed.
acceptPartial: Import valid entries and skip the invalid entries shown above
importCreates: The import creates these previously absent lists; an empty allowlist can change email selection:
importSummaryError: Could not preview that file. Check the JSON and try again.
importApplyError: Could not apply the import. Preview it again and check the channel configuration.
importSuccess: Import saved. Channel refresh has been requested.
importChooseFile: Choose a JSON file no larger than 2 MB.
addHelp: Find a channel from its handle, YouTube URL, feed URL or channel ID.
invalidCount: Enter a positive whole number of videos.
emptyVideos: No videos found for this range.
emptyChannels: No channels found. Add a channel to begin.
loadError: Could not load data. Check the service and try again.
resolveError: Could not find that channel. Check the address and try again.
help_smtp: Check your email configuration and credentials.
help_cookie: Check or replace the saved YouTube cookies.
help_auth: Reconnect the YouTube account and check its credentials.
help_quota: BBYEN will retry automatically after a delay.
help_other: Check the service logs, then try the refresh again.
addError: Could not save the channel. Try again.
added: Channel saved. Channel details will appear after refresh.
refreshRequested: Refresh requested. The list will update when it finishes.
invalidDates: Choose a valid date range that does not include a future day.
removeConfirm: Remove this channel from manual tracking? Its video history and preferences will be kept.
removed: Channel removed. The channel list will update after refresh.
settingError: Could not save the notification setting.
